moc.chu: The guest star of 1054 occurred during the reign of the Emperor Renzong of the Song dynasty (960–1279).
The Song Huiyao by contrast mentions a visibility of the guest star of only 23 days, but this is after mentioning visibility during daylight.
When the French astronomer Charles Messier watched for the return of Halley's Comet in 1758, he confused the nebula for the comet
The Crab Nebula was identified as the supernova remnant of SN 1054 between 1921 and 1942
